{{Quote|I don't guess about anything, sir. We're working with hard information that's coming in from Tactical and Operational, and where there are gaps, they stay as gaps until we have data.|CSF Captain Lon Shevu discussing the bombing of The Elite Hotel|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
'''Tactical and Operational''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] threat assessment [[Special forces/Legends|tactical force]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. It would respond in the aftermath of a dangerous incident on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to provide information to the CSF [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]] at the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] [[Galactic City Strategic Center|Strategic Center]].<ref name="Bloodlines" /> In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> in the aftermath of the [[Coruscant terrorist attacks and riots|bombing]] of [[The Elite (hotel)|The Elite]] [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], Tactical and Operational assessed the resulting damage, including the kind of [[Bomb/Legends|explosives]] that were used and how many [[Death/Legends|deaths]] and injuries had been sustained.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tactical and Operational was introduced in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'', a [[2007]] novel authored by [[Karen Traviss]] as the second novel of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="Bloodlines" />
